_doc: Device fleet. Virtual devices run on the laptop (one process each) behind their own Toxiproxy link; Wokwi boards run in the browser simulator. Subjects must match har_split.json. network profiles: latency/jitter ms, bandwidth KB/s (0 = unlimited). drift: when triggered (attack scene 'drift', or automatically at 'auto_start_round' if not null) the device's data shifts to the listed activities (label shift, as in the research), mixed with drift-source subjects. Battery: percent at start, drain per training round, recharge per idle round.

drift_dropout._doc: Drift-causal dropout (research mechanism, MNAR). Each round the device computes D_indep (fldemo/drift.py: squared L2 between the mean frozen-random-feature embedding of its current data and its first-seen reference, as in drift-causal-fl/src/drift/model_independent.py). If D >= min_score it skips with probability sigmoid(alpha + beta*D), seeded per device+round. Calibrated: clean D = 0.0, drifted D ~ 0.23 -> p ~ 0.83.
